reply.summary: Telrn is a dark-haired knight of a topsy-turvy order who wields a glowing emerald band that builds shields, fires blasts and carries him aloft. He misspells his own title and quarrels with a rival in yellow.

feats.scene: Telrn fires a green bolt that collapses a whole warehouse.
Telrn raises a glowing barrier and holds off a barrage of cannon shells.

reply.summary: Inureium is a blue-eyed boy of a chalky-skinned race who flies, breathes fire, stares frost and shrugs off blows. His quarrelsome parents make home life miserable, and his friends rescue him from it.

feats.scene: Inureium breathes a plume of flame that melts a bridge.
Inureium shakes off a falling tower and sulks.

reply.summary: Liseonnu is a quilled hybrid beast made in a mad surgeon's lab, sworn to obey a code of cruel laws. He stalks city streets with his pack and, at the end, sides with his maker.

feats.scene: Liseonnu swipes a claw through a lamppost.
Liseonnu keeps charging through a line of police batons.

reply.summary: Iantitau is a dark-haired criminal who vanishes from one alley and appears in another, armed with a plain cane and an ordinary pistol. Nobody ever learns how the trick works.

feats.scene: Iantitau fires a pistol from a spot he was not standing in a moment ago.
Iantitau takes a punch to the jaw and blinks away.

reply.summary: Artieru is a warlord from a far tomorrow who flies in a full suit of armor, fires beams from a lance and rides a time machine surrounded by robot drones. A trick about ancestry sends him home.

feats.scene: Artieru blasts a laboratory wall to rubble with a lance of force.
Artieru absorbs a barrage of rockets inside his armor.

reply.summary: Iuanmi is a black-haired gangster queen who runs the underworld of a mid-sized city out of spite for the men around her. She is a crack shot and a skilled grappler who wins with charm.

feats.scene: Iuanmi flips a bodyguard over her shoulder and onto a card table.
Iuanmi shrugs off a slap and smiles.

reply.summary: Rentser is a future thief in scarab armor who joins a gang of time raiders after being promised his sister could be saved. He steals the name of a beetle hero and travels through time to rewrite the past.

feats.scene: Rentser rips a gash in a time ship's hull with a scarab blade.
Rentser survives a blast that nearly shatters his vessel.

reply.summary: Veorn is a cannibal king of a clan of flame trolls, stronger than the rest of his kind from feasting on his rivals. He joins a cabal of sorcerers to steal books of magic and ends up beheaded.

feats.scene: Veorn hurls a burning boulder through a stone wall.
Veorn walks out of a fire that blackens the stones around him.

reply.summary: Anuntta is a blond hero that exists only because a mischievous imp reversed everyone's gender. He appears on a space station and does little before the trick fades.

feats.scene: Anuntta shoves a console cart across the station deck.
Anuntta bumps a doorframe and rubs his head.

reply.summary: Vartaumi is a dark-haired forger who staged his own funeral to dodge the law. A young hero in a lightning-powered suit tracked him down and he was caught among his fake bills.

feats.scene: Vartaumi flings a roll of coins at a pursuer.
Vartaumi takes a tackle onto a printing table.

reply.summary: Resanu is a genderless, purple, eyeless creature of death freed by accident in a possible tomorrow. Its body stretches like taffy, its touch kills and it glides after victims at ruinous speed.

feats.scene: Resanu reaches through a vault wall and kills its target with one touch.
Resanu overtakes a fleeing runner in an eyeblink.

reply.summary: Anile is a white-eyed reaper who lives inside a river of raw velocity and collects those who race too hard. Wearing a calm mask, he waits at the finish line of every contest.

feats.scene: Anile crosses a stadium before the starting gun finishes echoing.
Anile takes a champion runner's last breath with a single glance.

reply.summary: Tauerosa is a genderless red-eyed antibody grown by a river of speed to kill anything that harms it. It also collects the souls of runners whose time has come, arriving as a grey blur.

feats.scene: Tauerosa lunges across a museum floor and drains a fleeing runner in an instant.
Tauerosa closes a continent-wide gap while its target blinks.

reply.summary: Serntrau is a bald, yellow-eyed grim reaper of speed that feeds on life and velocity, with claws, brute strength and a tough hide. It tried to swallow a young runner's pure speed and died when the boy let it loose.

feats.scene: Serntrau claws a trench across a dusty plain in one rush.
Serntrau stands in a roaring blast of released speed before it ends him.

reply.summary: Valceo is a black-haired boatman turned criminal who poles through canals and meets a quick end in his first outing. Little is recorded of his methods beyond a grudge against a tiny hero.

feats.scene: Valceo swings his long pole and cracks a crate lid.
Valceo is knocked off his gondola into the canal.

reply.summary: Eolvant is a red-eyed tyrant who seized an undersea throne by civil war and hunted down every rival ruler. When a young heir escaped, he dispatched armies and a pirate to drag the boy back.

feats.scene: Eolvant brings a trident down and splits a reef-built hall.
Eolvant shrugs off a hail of harpoons on his throne.

reply.summary: Rnianu is a general in a drowned king's army who wears a mask that fires thin lasers. He cut down a mercenary with a single beam and fell to a hail of bullets after his helmet broke.

feats.scene: Rnianu fires lasers from his mask and drops a mercenary on the spot.
Rnianu takes a punch while his helmet holds.

reply.summary: Rnuontva is a sea raider whose identity has dissolved into his black helmet, a man who hates so completely that nothing else is left. He wants a nation for himself and thinks every cruelty is justified.

feats.scene: Rnuontva drives his fist through a wooden hatch.
Rnuontva stands unmoved by a thrown anchor.

reply.summary: Ciston is a hired diver in a suit of dark armor, sent by a toy-maker's firm to take down a sea hero around the early eleven years of the century. His few moves are recorded in a single mission.

feats.scene: Ciston rams a harbor gate with an armored shoulder.
Ciston lands on a dock plank and the armor holds.

reply.summary: Neserrn is a red-eyed, hairless hero from a mirror reality, a sea raider turned defender who fights on the side of the law. Little else is known about his deeds.

feats.scene: Neserrn hammers a smuggler's crate shut with one fist.
Neserrn steps through a doorway wrecked by a bomb and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Rinallu is a bald, masked crime boss who ran a gang until a vigilante's radio voice led police to his door. Nothing is recorded of him beyond that single arrest.

feats.scene: Rinallu swings a club at a detective and misses.
Rinallu is dragged into a cell and shouts about his lawyers.

reply.summary: Eoamo is a retired thug in a suit with glove-tip dispensers that puff out deadly spores. His costume gets stolen from a police locker, and he later helps a convict slip out of prison.

feats.scene: Eoamo puffs spore gas into a stairwell and clears it of guards.
Eoamo coughs through a punch and stumbles on.

reply.summary: Tastisu is a grey, white-haired guard who is half caped hero and half hulking undead, babbling in broken sentences. He holds the gate of a bat-shaped fortress and brawls with a powerful flyer.

feats.scene: Tastisu blows a tunnel wall into a spray of masonry.
Tastisu keeps swinging after a collapsing ceiling lands on him.

reply.summary: Anuiarrau is an ancient black-eyed lord who practiced dark rites from an island in a deep lake and survives by breathing underwater. Every hundred years he rises with his witch daughter to claim a fresh army of students.

feats.scene: Anuiarrau raises an island out of the lake with a chanted curse.
Anuiarrau remains alive after the island sinks again.

reply.summary: Anorinau is a blue-eyed, silent costumed champion in a corporate team, a grim figure who never speaks and rarely shows his face. He is the cold third of the most marketable trio.

feats.scene: Anorinau drives a blade through a car door in complete silence.
Anorinau absorbs a baton blow and does not flinch.

reply.summary: Stinassir is a black-haired citizen of a bright heavenly world, a bringer of death who rides cosmic skis. He glides toward each doomed target in complete calm.

feats.scene: Stinassir carves a streak of light across the sky and ends a doomed mortal.
Stinassir passes through a storm of fire unmarked.

reply.summary: Nausele is a black-haired duke, over-ambitious, who murdered his king to take the crown and tried to slay the heir. A skilled rider and swordsman, he is overthrown by locals and a pair of visitors.

feats.scene: Nausele cleaves a shield in two from horseback.
Nausele is unhorsed in the charge and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Vanil is a black-haired gunwoman who opposed a squadron of daring flyers and died in her very first outing. She relies on her aim rather than any special trick.

feats.scene: Vanil fires a pistol that shatters a lantern from across a hangar.
Vanil takes a blow to the shoulder and fires back.

reply.summary: Torranu is a blue-eyed former ballerina who turned her grace into deadly combat and entered a death tournament on an island. She pirouettes through rivals until a faster fighter ends her run.

feats.scene: Torranu spins and heels a rival through a paper screen.
Torranu absorbs a kick and slides back without falling.

reply.summary: Aulsas is a hero of a Saturday-morning team who turns himself into a living bolt of lightning to cross the sky. At speeds beyond light he can reach past eras, and he throws sparks and shields.

feats.scene: Aulsas hurls a bolt of lightning that shatters a pylon tower.
Aulsas streaks across the sky faster than light and arrives in another century.

reply.summary: Iumsautor is a bald villain whose costume lets him fly, a short-lived opponent of a team of oddball heroes. His only trick is the suit itself, and he leaves nothing behind but a feather.

feats.scene: Iumsautor dives and kicks a guard rail loose.
Iumsautor skids across a rooftop and gets up.

reply.summary: Lorreo is a blue-eyed, black-haired criminal who fought a stretchy detective and was beaten in her very first outing. Little survives of her story beyond a spidery nickname.

feats.scene: Lorreo throws a vase at a rooftop pursuer.
Lorreo drops from a fire escape onto a trash heap.

reply.summary: Iuristu is a terrorist mastermind who planned the escape of a condemned man and assembled parts for a deadly ray machine. She blew up her own mountain castle to fake the death of her pursuers.

feats.scene: Iuristu detonates the whole castle on her mountainside with a single switch.
Iuristu is cornered and takes a rifle butt without a word.

reply.summary: Totiairn is a white-haired sorceress who opposed an invincible mystic and left only one appearance behind. Nothing is recorded of her spells beyond a reputation for dark craft.

feats.scene: Totiairn mutters a hex that shatters a row of candles and a glass door.
Totiairn staggers under a thrown book and keeps chanting.

reply.summary: Ammico is a black-haired sorceress who picked a fight with a disguised heroine and was gone after one issue. Nothing is recorded of her powers.

feats.scene: Ammico flings a witch-fire spark that sets a curtain alight.
Ammico crashes through a window and scrambles up.

reply.summary: Eorserau is a tall teacher given strength by cursed relics of a buffalo cult, who goes mad under their influence. A nuclear hero ended his rampage, and he later died in a magical disaster.

feats.scene: Eorserau charges through a school gate and uproots it from the pavement.
Eorserau keeps charging after a delivery truck hits him.

reply.summary: Iumrni is a black-haired bandit chief who dressed in antique clothes with modern guns and raided a port town. He fell with most of his crew in two quick gunfights.

feats.scene: Iumrni fires a submachine gun across a dock and shreds a barrel.
Iumrni takes a hit from a thrown crate and rallies his crew.

reply.summary: Oreeosi is a thorny British sorcerer who serves a green force and bends plants to his will. Roots and brambles surge from the ground wherever he strides.

feats.scene: Oreeosi calls up a mat of briars that tears up a stretch of road.
Oreeosi is wrapped in bark that turns aside a thrown spear.

reply.summary: Nanvi is a pilot assigned to escort a bomber on a deadly mission, flying for an aircraft firm in a broken timeline. A winged warrior killed Nanvi in action.

feats.scene: Nanvi fires the wing guns and scatters a flight of attackers.
Nanvi rides out a hard turn that rattles the cockpit.

reply.summary: Salias is a bald frontier outlaw, a former slave who commanded a gang of bandits and captured a famed bounty hunter. Vengeful riders murdered him and all his men.

feats.scene: Salias fires a revolver and knocks a lantern off its hook.
Salias takes a saloon-door slam and keeps barking orders.

reply.summary: Sttescor is a black-haired thug who runs with a mob boss and goes by a dark nickname. Little is known beyond a few street scuffles.

feats.scene: Sttescor swings a pipe and bends a street sign.
Sttescor falls from a fence and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Aulamorni is a white-haired, one-armed menace from a winged people's homeworld, named for the blade he fights with. He prowls a rooftop city and his missing limb marks him in every fight.

feats.scene: Aulamorni drives his blade through a metal shutter.
Aulamorni lands from a ledge and resumes the attack.

reply.summary: Valneo is a blond, nimble dealer who became undead at a party and turned it into a business selling brains to wealthy victims. He extorts officials and sneers at honest work.

feats.scene: Valneo shoves a rival through a restaurant window.
Valneo gets up after a car clips him and sneers.

reply.summary: Ntoce is a small-town detective infected by an alien parasite that lets him turn matter into unstable explosives. He lobs the charged objects with great aim and lifts boulders over his head.

feats.scene: Ntoce primes a boulder to burst and throws it at a lorry.
Ntoce takes a hard tackle and keeps firing.

reply.summary: Eonnumiu is a blond, blue-eyed guard posted at a remote island research site. She watches the gates and keeps order among odd colleagues.

feats.scene: Eonnumiu drives a baton into a trespasser's shin.
Eonnumiu takes a shove into a fence and stays on her feet.

reply.summary: Rnuntnol is a green-eyed, hairless, pale warlord of a shape-shifting race who led a mining firm's troops against an invading hero. He sparked a panic with his followers and was beaten by a gathering of heroes.

feats.scene: Rnuntnol smashes a mining rig into scrap with a swing of his fist.
Rnuntnol stays upright after a rockfall in his own quarry.

reply.summary: Cornorrni is a ring-wearing soldier of a corps fueled by rage, spending her days in irrational fury. A crimson band on her finger answers only to hatred.

feats.scene: Cornorrni vomits a bolt of crimson heat that melts a gun battery.
Cornorrni keeps clawing through a hail of fire.

reply.summary: Nusll is a blue-skinned winged princess of a distant planet who was captured, tortured and reborn as second-in-command of a rage-powered corps. Her rage replaced her pride, and she follows her leader into war.

feats.scene: Nusll spits a blast of rage-fire that shatters a hilltop battery.
Nusll endures a full broadside and keeps flying toward it.

reply.summary: Onenum is a blue-skinned winged noblewoman who watched her family die, lost herself to blinding fury and gained a crimson ring. She later drifts from one team to another across the stars.

feats.scene: Onenum vomits a gout of blood-red fire that melts a siege tower.
Onenum climbs from a crater after a heavy bombardment.

reply.summary: Ianium is a masked, tall interrogator who sees all things as black and white, hiding his love of torture from his teammates. A fellow agent shoots him dead after learning he is deranged.

feats.scene: Ianium drives a fist into a captive's ribs during a grim interrogation.
Ianium takes a hard shove and keeps muttering about justice.
